inputs: SP 800-38A Appendix F.1.1 AES-128-ECB four-block vector
expected: All four ciphertext blocks match the NIST values; decryption recovers all four plaintext blocks
limitations: One official four-block case; it checks the ECB formula and vector, not protocol behavior.

inputs: The same 16-byte plaintext block repeated twice under AES-128-ECB
expected: The two ciphertext blocks are identical
limitations: Definitional demonstration; not an attack on AES.

inputs: The third ciphertext block of the NIST ECB vector decrypted independently
expected: Independent decryption recovers the same third plaintext block as full decryption
limitations: Demonstrates block independence on one fixed block; not a benchmark.

inputs: 20-byte and 16-byte plaintexts padded with the CMS/PKCS#7 rule for a 16-byte block
expected: 20 bytes become 32 with twelve 0x0c bytes; 16 bytes become 32 with sixteen 0x10 bytes; unpadding restores both
limitations: Padding mechanics only; it does not test every malformed padding case.
